name: INFOTEC Centro de Datos Aguascalientes
developer: INFOTEC Centro de Investigación e Innovación en Tecnologías de la Información y Comunicación
notes: DCD reported the Aguascalientes center opening with about US$23M invested and Tier III certification; INFOTEC lists the service and EPI/TIA-942 map lists Centro de Datos Aguascalientes with ANSI/TIA-942-C Rated 3 certification expiring 2027-08-07.

name: Neutral Networks Tijuana data center
notes: Arelion announced a fully diverse Tijuana-San Diego route from its new PoP in the Neutral Networks data center in Tijuana; DCD also covered the route.

name: MTP Edge Tijuana
notes: Data Center Map lists MTP Edge Tijuana at Calle Emiliano Zapata 202-206 in Tijuana, operated by MTP.

name: Edgenet Mexicali / Cd. Obregon Data Center
developer: Edgenet Data Technologies, S.A. de C.V.
notes: Datacenters.com provider listing shows Edgenet's Cd. Obregon Data Center at Calle Obregon, 21821 Mexicali, Baja California, Mexico.

name: Edgenet La Paz Data Center
developer: Edgenet Data Technologies, S.A. de C.V.
notes: Datacenters.com lists EdgeNet's Sala La Paz data center in La Paz, Baja California Sur as regional digital infrastructure for local processing and colocation-type needs.

name: Fermaca Digital City
notes: Mexican government/Fermaca announced a natural-gas-powered data center campus near Durango city; trade press reports 250 MW planned capacity and about US$2.7B investment, with associated gas pipeline and power plant.

name: Layer 9 Project Falcon / Guanajuato hyperscale campus
notes: Layer 9 says Project Falcon has financing, land, and PPAs for a 96 MW data center in Bajio; its release and DCD reported groundbreaking in Guanajuato in October 2022.

name: ODATA DC QR04
developer: ODATA, an Aligned Data Centers company
notes: ODATA/Aligned announced QR04 near San Miguel de Allende; ODATA facility page lists 24 MW IT power and the Guanajuato government says first 12 MW phase is operational.
